blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – Negros Occidental province is hosting the 22nd Organic World Congress (OWC) of the International Federation of Organic Agriculture Movements (IFOAM) next week, Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson had told reporters here. Lacson said the gathering from Nov. 23 to 25 will bring together some 2,000 delegates from across the global organic value chain
